definitions.gloss: sorcery, black magic, spell, curse technique
definitions.explanation: The practice of using supernatural or spiritual means—such as incantations, rituals, or cursed objects—to influence events or harm others.

examples.english: In this region, many legends related to sorcery remain.

notes:
Refers to supernatural practices involving curses, incantations, or ritual magic. Historically associated with folk religion and shamanism in Japan, the word has gained modern popularity through manga and anime.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {呪術|じゅじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use sorcery
- {呪術|じゅじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to cast a spell
- {呪術|じゅじゅつ}{師|し}: sorcerer, shaman
- {呪術|じゅじゅつ}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: magical, pertaining to sorcery

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{魔術|まじゅつ}→魔術：17994_majutsu⟧: magic (Western-style sorcery or stage magic)
- ⟦{呪|のろ}い→呪い：15822_noroi⟧: curse (the result rather than the practice)
- {妖術|ようじゅつ}: witchcraft, dark magic (literary)
- {陰陽術|おんみょうじゅつ}: onmyodo arts (Japanese esoteric practice)
